subject.title: Feature Request: Stream Repetition Safeguard (Halt & Confirm)

question: What product contract should OpenClaw use when assistant text stream repetition is detected: abort-only, halt-and-confirm, retry/failover, session rollback, or another policy?
rationale: The source boundary is clear, but default strictness, false-positive tolerance, resume/cancel semantics, and how to sanitize session history are product decisions automation should not invent.

options.title: Approve a core stream guard design
options.body: Define default thresholds, user alert wording, abort/retry/resume behavior, and session cleanup before implementing the detector in the embedded-agent stream path.

options.title: Defer to timeout work first
options.body: Keep this issue open while generation-timeout and provider-watchdog policy settles, then revisit semantic stream detection with that context.

options.title: Reject resume semantics
options.body: Allow detection only to abort and quarantine the suspect turn, avoiding a manual resume path that may continue poisoned output.

recommendation.title: Approve a core stream guard design
recommendation.body: Define default thresholds, user alert wording, abort/retry/resume behavior, and session cleanup before implementing the detector in the embedded-agent stream path.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is the strongest routing candidate from configurable loop-detection history and adjacent core runtime policy work.
